Databricks Data Engineer

Location: Nashville, TN
Employment type: Contract
Indicative rate: $56–$66/hr

Build and optimize scalable data pipelines and curated data products on Databricks. You will develop ingestion and transformation workflows for large datasets and prepare trusted data for analytics, reporting, and related business initiatives. Partner with stakeholders to translate data needs into maintainable solutions. Improve pipeline performance, reliability, and data quality across batch processing and enterprise analytics workloads.

Required qualifications
Experience building and maintaining data pipelines with Databricks.
Hands-on PySpark experience for large-scale data processing.
Strong SQL skills for data transformation and analysis.
Experience designing batch ETL/ELT workflows.
Experience ingesting and transforming structured or semi-structured data.
Ability to build curated datasets for analytics and reporting.
Experience optimizing pipeline performance and reliability.
Preferred qualifications
Experience supporting AI or machine learning data initiatives.
